content.text: Digital creators in regions where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-explained-digital-creators-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal are restricted face significant challenges. Building a reliable online store for accepting crypto payments is essential for these creators. COREMERCH's [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-4|The Full]]-guide-crypto-payments-tanzanian-online-sellers|infrastructure]] offers a way forward with Stack 02 on Cloudflare Pages, ensuring you have robust tools for hosting, backend logic, and payment processing. Within 48 hours, you can have a fully operational store without relying on traditional payment gateways. This guide walks you through the essential steps to set up your crypto store effectively.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The critical issue facing digital creators is access to payment processing. Traditional platforms often exclude users in specific regions, creating barriers to monetizing their digital products. COREMERCH’s infrastructure circumvents these restrictions by providing ownership and control over your online store. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages, you can host your store without dependence on third-party services. The integration of NOWPayments allows for seamless crypto transactions, making it a viable solution when conventional payment methods fail. This architecture is designed for resilience and autonomy, enabling you to thrive in any economic climate.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start the deployment process, ensure you have the necessary tools and resources. You will need a domain name for your store, which can be purchased through various registrars. Familiarize yourself with GitHub or Cloudflare for hosting and version control. Additionally, sign up for NOWPayments to facilitate crypto transactions. Ensure you have access to your digital products ready for upload. Finally, have your branding elements, such as logos and marketing materials, prepared to establish your store’s identity upon launch. This preparation will streamline your deployment process and set you up for success.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by deploying your backend with Cloudflare Workers and Supabase to manage orders and product delivery. This setup is crucial as it handles incoming transactions and stores order data securely. Next, integrate NOWPayments to process crypto payments effortlessly. This step ensures that your store can accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. After configuring the payment gateway, test the order flow to confirm that payments confirm on-chain and that file deliveries trigger correctly. This testing phase is pivotal for maintaining a smooth customer experience, ensuring that every transaction is processed as intended.
Infrastructure sovereignty means you own every aspect of your store.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have completed the setup and testing, it’s time to go live. Promote your store through social media and leverage your existing networks to drive traffic. Direct potential customers to your shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to start generating sales. Monitor the first transaction closely to identify any issues that may arise. This initial sale will serve as a test of your entire system. Ensure that the payment confirmation and product delivery work seamlessly, and use this experience to refine your processes further. Continuous monitoring and adaptation will help you optimize your store's performance.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

With your store operational, the focus shifts to scaling your offerings. Begin by adding more products to your inventory, ensuring you have quality content that meets your audience's needs. Utilize Supabase to manage your product catalog efficiently. Explore marketing strategies to attract a broader audience, such as collaborations with other creators or paid advertising. As your sales grow, consider upgrading your capabilities with the Edge Commerce Stack for enhanced functionality, including SPF/DKIM/DMARC configurations to improve email deliverability. This proactive approach will position your store for lasting success in the digital marketplace.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

The setup sequence matters because each component depends on the previous one being correctly configured. Start with NOWPayments: create your account, configure wallet addresses for each coin you want to accept, generate the API key, and note the IPN secret key you will set. Then configure the backend: in Stack 01, deploy the Google Apps Script Web App and note its URL; in Stack 02, deploy the Cloudflare Worker and note its URL. Set that URL as the webhook endpoint in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Then configure the storefront. Then run a real mainnet test — send actual crypto to your configured wallet address, confirm NOWPayments detects it, confirm the webhook fires, and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link.
No subscriptions or hidden fees—just straightforward access.

For those exploring options for a robust digital store infrastructure, consider the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). This solution offers a comprehensive setup with enhanced features, ensuring that your store is well-equipped for growth and scalability. Check out the offerings at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. This combination allows you to bypass traditional payment systems and maintain full control over your operations.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Apps Script for deployment, taking 4-6 hours. Stack 02 utilizes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, deployed in 48 hours with end-to-end testing, offering a more robust infrastructure for handling transactions.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, you can host a digital product store on both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages. Both options provide reliable hosting solutions, but Cloudflare Pages offers enhanced capabilities for integrating backend logic and payment processing.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept with NOWPayments?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a diverse range of digital currencies. This flexibility makes it an ideal payment processing solution for crypto stores.
How long does it take to deploy the Edge Commerce Stack?
The Edge Commerce Stack can be deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. This includes configuring essential features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC and testing the entire system before handoff.
